approach: Static recompilation of Game.exe to C with our own translator; a new Windows and DirectX 7 runtime on SDL3 and Vulkan; checked frame by frame against the original code.
notes: Alpha: the whole game plays, but only the author's two computers have tested it. Bring your own copy; the download checks it and builds the game on your computer. With every option off it plays as shipped. Options include any resolution and widescreen, longer draw distance, ray-traced shadows and reflections, FSR 2, DLSS on Windows, 16 cars, fan cars and maps, and hot-plug controllers.
